From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Subject: DPA redline + temporary routing proposal (Order Form)

Hi Sofia / Contracts team —

Attached is our initial DPA redline and a short controller/processor mapping for the Order Form scope (see Redwood_DPA_redline_v2.pdf and OrderForm-Sentinel-draft.pdf). Key points I want to surface: 

- We accepted most of your SCC alignment edits but proposed a limited liability carveout in clause 4.2 — highlighted in yellow.
- For cross-border transfers, we propose a short-term transfer-impact addendum to lock routing to EU-only regions for the first 90 days while we complete the subprocessor evidence exchange.
- We included a proposed exhibit for processor delegation (dpa_exhibit-delegation.docx) that enumerates the expected subprocessor list and the evidence we can provide (SOC2 link, encryption at rest, KMS architecture summary).

Can you confirm whether the routing restriction is acceptable as an interim mitigation? If so, we can provisionally sign the Order Form and ship the full DPA via DocuSign once evidence is shared.

Requested next steps: 
1) Contracts: review our liability language and confirm if a counterproposal is required.
2) Privacy/Legal (you): confirm the routing window and the acceptable evidence set.
3) Ops: if routing is acceptable, Redwood will restrict processing to eu-central1 for the initial phase.

Timeline: we’re hoping for a signed Order Form + DPA within two weeks to hit the onboarding window.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112

Ben —

Thanks for the quick turn. A few immediate items from our side after a first pass: 

- Clause 4.2 (liability cap) as redlined is a blocker for our legal team. We need either a higher cap for breaches affecting PHI (we flagged a proposed text in the attached pdf) or an explicit carve-out for indemnity tied to willful misconduct.
- The interim routing is acceptable in principle but we need formal confirmation that data will not route to APAC or US regions at any point during onboarding.
- We require a live link to your latest SOC2 report and a short KMS architecture diagram (the latter can be redacted) prior to countersignature.

Attached: Sentinel_conforming_clause_4.2.pdf (proposed language).

Can you loop in Redwood Legal to work the liability language and confirm the SOC2/KMS link? If you can get that to us in 48 hours we’ll aim to return a countersigned Order Form to meet your two-week target.

Cheers,

Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA redline + temporary routing proposal — suggested language and evidence package

Ben / Karthik —

Thanks for the context. I had a look at the redline and attached exhibit; high-level suggestions below. I also attached a short doc with the insertion language I recommend (dpa_exhibit-delegation.docx).

1) Clause 4.2 (liability) — suggested approach: 
   - Option A (preferred for speed): Retain current cap but add a narrow PHI exception limited to direct damages for unauthorized access where Redwood is demonstrably at fault; add a mutual effort clause for investigation and remediation.
   - Option B (if customer pushes): Raise the cap for PHI incidents to 2x subscription fees for the prior 12 months, but keep the broader cap for non-PHI incidents.
   Language snippets in the attachment. Both are designed to be short and commercially acceptable.

2) SCCs / Controller-Processor mapping: We should include an explicit table in the Order Form appendix defining: 'Sentinel Health — Controller', 'Redwood Inference — Processor (for inference call processing)', 'Redwood — Joint Controller for anonymized model training telemetry' (only if telemetry is enabled; default = off). This reduces ambiguity.

3) Temporary routing: Ops has confirmed we can restrict processing to eu-central1 for the initial 90-day onboarding window and log region decisions. Monica confirms logs will indicate any deviation and we can provide a weekly snapshot. We should add a 90-day review checkpoint in the DPA to either remove or extend the routing restriction based on evidence exchange.

4) Evidence package: We can provide a read-only SOC2 link (redacted) and a one-page KMS architecture diagram. Recommend delivering these via Redacted-Drive link rather than embedding in email. I added the drive link placeholder in the related_links field.

Next steps for Ben: send Option A + the Order Form appendix table to Sentinel with an operations confirmation and the Drive link for SOC2/KMS. For recordkeeping, add this to HubSpot under deal D-4472.

I will be available Monday if Sentinel wants to run through the language live.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

Attachments: dpa_exhibit-delegation.docx

- Liability: we will proceed with Option A (narrow PHI exception + mutual investigation clause). Draft language attached in Redwood_DPA_redline_v2.pdf (updated).
- Routing: Redwood will enforce EU-only processing (eu-central1) for the first 90 days of the engagement. We will provide weekly confirmation snapshots and include a 90-day DPA checkpoint to review transfer impact.
- Evidence: Laura will provide a redacted SOC2 link and a one-page KMS diagram via the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDPA. Expect delivery of those artifacts by EOD Monday.

If that aligns with Sentinel's needs, we will prepare the Order Form + DPA for signature via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123. Target: countersign by 2028-07-21 to keep onboarding on schedule.

Please reply with either: 
1) countersign instruction, or
2) a short note indicating which element you want to discuss live (liability / routing / evidence).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.
